title: Evidence and external gate boundaries
rule: Local engine, tree, and reference-client proofs may merge without a fidelity, assistive-technology, model, vendor, or payment claim. P09 X01 through X06 and the published-claim checks cannot pass by proxy. The compat probe is a feasibility check. An unavailable external proof is inventoried, pointed at its P09 gate, and left unpassed.
alternatives: Mark X01 passed because the local probe hashed parts.
Accept a screen-reader plan as the X02 transcript.
Let a fixture client stand in for a vendor client.
